title: Third time's a charm for Arkansaw in Meteorite
excerpt: Lindsay Park veteran ends 14-month drought with a $1 million Cranbourne payday
content:
“He was in a nice rhythm. Jamie (Mott) took his time coming across. We ended up in a great position from the wide barrier, and I love the way he fought it out.

“He’s had three runs here. He was extremely unlucky in the first one, ran second to Jigsaw who ran 1.08 something and then he’s come out today. So, to get this result is huge.

“He’s a special horse and was one of the original girls’ horses that we bought, so the girls have been on a great ride and well done to Yulong who had the slot.”

Mott said he lobbed in a perfect spot from his wide gate, and the horse did the rest.

“I was confident the Hayes boys had him here in great shape,” he said.

“They mentioned they did some jumping with him during the week, and I do know than can really spark up a horse, especially ones that are racing well to get that little bit extra out of them.

“They had been running on down the middle all day, but we drew 13, so I had to play it by ear. He began great. I thought Mazu might go a little faster than he did and I tucked in behind him for a furlong or so and then got to his outside at the 600 (metres) and he towed me there.

“We put Mazu away before the corner and I was a little worried there would be a late swooper coming as they have been all day. Charm Stone got to him, but basically, they went head and head and he fought her off well.”
